The climate in Varna

Varna is about 50 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 29°C; the coldest is January, when nights average 0°C. Around 630 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in June (about 84 mm).

Varna is on the Black Sea coast and the sea softens its climate: summers are less hot than inland, and autumn is warm and long. The sea is usually warm enough for swimming from June to September. Winters are mild, but north-easterly winds from Dobruja sometimes bring hard frost, snow and blizzards.
